Just what I was looking for. I recently asked this on the 2160: Epilogue DeviantArt page.

If you are willing to, may you include an alternate version of this map which also outlines the borders of all countries completely independent of the American System?

One more thing, Serbia’s borders seem to change depending on which map you look at (2160: Epilogue and the European Association Maps) despite never losing any territory. Perhaps it could be depicted on the 2160: Epilogue Map similar to how it was shown on the European Association’s Map?
